source: Screenshot of the comment and its reply, taken by the creator about 2 hours after they were posted. The automated snapshot was not run for this round because the Instagram API token is not set up yet.
note: Recorded before the 24-hour deadline. The comment had 10 likes and the reply 4 at the time of the screenshot. The reply is by the same person and adds to the comment, so the two were built together. A third comment, 'Add picachu' by ancientpro_gamer with 11 likes, was built the same day.

winner.text: Yaaaay gåmson 🐙 btw can you make him immortal

reply.text: and give him a squid friend named Tåhgong who is nice

decision_note: Gåmson is immortal: tank shells and rockets flatten him for a moment and he pops back up holding everything, so the army can no longer win his loot back; he wears a pale gold halo. Only a bump from the cube makes him let go. Tåhgong is a coral squid who lives beside his pool and is nice: while Gåmson is out, he takes things back off the rock to their owners, waves at the cube, hugs it when bumped, and gives it a charm now and then.

also_built.note: Built as an original off-brand electric critter named 'Picachu' (the comment's spelling), not a copy of the trademarked character: round ears, a battery gauge on its belly, a plug for a tail. It zaps people when charged, overcharges the park rides, gives the cube a burst of speed, keeps out of the water, and its battery can be stolen by Gåmson.
